purpose: Prevent sparse-width capacity, latent factorization, normalization, bounded activation, balancing, and expert geometry from entering as one uninterpretable bundle.

evidence_basis.supported: K3 combines latent projection normalization, SiTU-GLU, Quantile Balancing, extreme expert sparsity, and Per-Head Muon in one mature system
evidence_basis.insufficient: the local review does not contain implementation-complete LatentMoE, SiTU-GLU, Quantile Balancing, histogram, or update equations

evidence_basis.supported: extreme MoE sparsity cannot be separated from normalization, bounded activation, balancing, optimizer, and systems evidence
evidence_basis.insufficient: whole-system feasibility is not local component attribution

evidence_basis.supported: normalized low-rank bottlenecks and fine-grained routed experts can coexist at scale
evidence_basis.insufficient: DeepSeekMoE geometry and quality do not define K3 LatentMoE

evidence_basis.supported: a hybrid sparse model can expose far more total than active parameters
evidence_basis.insufficient: 128-expert/six-active geometry trained on 25T tokens is not a Speck optimum

hard_blockers: the sequence and depth parents are not selected
the medium-scale single-device versus expert-parallel hardware envelope is not named
implementation-complete primary equations and code identities for LatentMoE are not pinned
implementation-complete SiTU-GLU equation and numerical limits are not pinned
implementation-complete Quantile Balancing target, margin, histogram, bias-update, and distributed-reduction rules are not pinned
no local dropless routed-expert reference or dispatch kernel exists
no storage/memory budget covers expert weights, optimizer state, activation dispatch, and checkpoints
no intervention policy for routing collapse, overflow, or loss spikes is preregistered

required_decomposition_order.intervention: replace selected dense SwiGLU modules with direct top-k routed SwiGLU experts plus one shared expert
required_decomposition_order.purpose: establish whether conditional width helps before latent or stability machinery
required_decomposition_order.forbidden: LatentMoE projection, bounded activation, quantile balancing, or changing sequence/depth

required_decomposition_order.intervention: direct experts versus exact primary-source LatentMoE factorization
required_decomposition_order.purpose: isolate latent parameterization at fixed expert count, top-k, active parameters, routing, activation, and balancing
required_decomposition_order.forbidden: adding normalization in the same step

required_decomposition_order.intervention: add only the exact primary-source latent RMSNorm placement
required_decomposition_order.purpose: isolate scale control from low-rank capacity

required_decomposition_order.intervention: plain SwiGLU versus one exact frozen bounded activation
required_decomposition_order.purpose: separate outlier/stability behavior from latent projection
required_decomposition_order.forbidden: mixing clamping and SiTU-GLU in the same candidate

required_decomposition_order.intervention: auxiliary load loss versus bias balancing versus exact Quantile Balancing
required_decomposition_order.purpose: select on quality, load tails, margins, communication, and instability rather than mean load

required_decomposition_order.intervention: vary total experts and top-k only after the preceding mechanism is stable
required_decomposition_order.purpose: find the total/active capacity and hardware-utilization frontier

initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.placement: which FFN modules become MoE is fixed and identical across routed arms
initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.shared_experts: exactly one always-active shared expert in the initial comparison
initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.routing: top-k logits, selected-weight normalization, deterministic tie breaking, router precision, and jitter are explicit
initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.capacity: initial reference is dropless; any capacity factor, token dropping, padding, or overflow fallback creates a separate arm
initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.dispatch: expert token ordering, padding, combine weights, and backward reduction have a slow reference
initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.expert_initialization: dense-to-expert cloning versus independent initialization is frozen before training and cannot differ across compared routers
initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.active_parameter_definition: count shared plus selected routed expert weights, router work, latent projections, and token-dependent normalization separately
initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.total_parameter_definition: count every resident routed/shared expert, router, projection, normalization, and bias parameter
initial_conventional_moe_semantics_to_fr.optimizer: Muon/AdamW roles for router, expert, latent, norm, and balancing parameters are explicit

correctness_before_training: dense one-expert reduction where mathematically applicable
reference versus dispatched forward and input/parameter/router gradient parity
dropless token conservation and combine-order identity
zero-token and highly imbalanced expert batches
exact total/active parameter and analytic-FLOP accounting
expert weight, optimizer, activation, dispatch, communication, workspace, and fragmentation memory

load: tokens per expert and coefficient of variation
maximum, p95, and p99 expert load
routing: routing entropy and churn over training
numerics: activation and gradient maxima plus quantiles
non-finite values by module and optimizer role
loss spikes with pre-spike routing/load history

freeze_before_training: whether anticipatory routing or another rescue exists
intervention_policy_required.report: every trigger, duration, older-router identity, added compute, and post-intervention trajectory
intervention_policy_required.decision: frequent rescue is a stability failure, not invisible training infrastructure

matching_and_replication.dense_control: parameter/FLOP-matched dense SwiGLU under identical sequence/depth parent
views: time and energy to locked quality
matching_and_replication.quality: aggregate and every-source language-loss non-inferiority plus declared capability floors
matching_and_replication.proxy: three paired seed/data cells, no promotion authority
matching_and_replication.finalist: three seeds crossed with two data orders and at least ten tokens per larger active parameter
matching_and_replication.medium_transfer: named expert-parallel hardware with three paired cells and no primary-effect sign reversal

systems_gate.rule: total capacity is not free: a sparse arm must improve quality per active compute and retain small-batch serving after expert memory, dispatch, communication, and fragmentation

decision.next_action: obtain and pin the implementation-complete primary Stable LatentMoE specification and code before writing local equations
